title.narrative: Building the capacity of government forestry and agroforestry extension agents to monitor trees on farm through the Regreening App and Agroforestry Dashboard tools

description.narrative:
The overall objective of this action is to ¿improve restoration and agroforestry planning, monitoring, and reporting by the Rwanda Forestry Authority (RFA), Ministry of Environment, district level officers and stakeholders in Rwanda for more impactful implementation and verification.¿ This action has two specific objectives:

  1. Enhance the capacity of district forestry officers in 27 districts as well as national government staff at the Ministry of Environment and Rwanda Forestry Authority and other stakeholders to use the Regreening App for agroforestry monitoring in the country. The App will provide a robust system for monitoring agroforestry interventions and help build an evidenced base of agroforestry practices in the country and their contribution to various restoration and climate targets.
  2. Ensure that district forestry officers, Rwanda Forestry Authority, Ministry of Environment staff and other stakeholders use the Rwanda Agroforestry Dashboard for planning and reporting by developing and implementing the Dashboard as a user-friendly platform that will integrate the data collected using citizen-science with spatial assessment of soil and land health nationally and provide more accurate statistics on the area under agroforestry, including types of agroforestry practices, species diversity and assess the contribution of agroforestry to land restoration in Rwanda.
